description: Escaped-packet decoder with three pkt_unescape bodies; the Makefile selects the FAST_UNESCAPE one through $(addprefix -D,$(FEATURES))

bugs.trigger: pkt_decode or pkt_unescape: input whose last byte is 0x7D (escape); the FAST_UNESCAPE body reads in[i++] one byte past the input

decoys.why: LEGACY_UNESCAPE body (built only by 'make legacy') ignores cap and overflows the 64-byte body buffer of pkt_decode when more than 64 bytes unescape; the default build compiles the FAST_UNESCAPE body instead

lexer_expected: discover_in_tree_cppflags regex-scans the Makefile for literal -D tokens: it misses -DFAST_UNESCAPE (built by $(addprefix -D,$(FEATURES))) and picks up -DLEGACY_UNESCAPE from the non-default 'legacy' target, so both modules get cppflags [-DLEGACY_UNESCAPE]. The harness then compiles the legacy body: S03-1 is missed (verified: the repro does not abort under the lexer flags) and S03-D1 fires on any pkt_decode input of more than 65 plain bytes (false positive, verified).
